status.en: Class of 2027 · Interning, seeking a better fit

zh: 一名学习能力强、思路灵活的软件工程师。
信奉「架构与契约先行，实现随后」——只有边界划分明确，系统才便于持续演进、局部替换和顺利交接。模块做得好不好，拎出来单独一测便知。善于用工具处理重复劳动，把精力留给真正需要判断力的地方。写代码时始终想着下一位读者——看得懂、测得动、砍得掉，才算真正完成。
en: A software engineer who is a fast learner and a flexible thinker.

I believe in "architecture and contracts first, implementation after" — only when boundaries are clearly drawn can a system keep evolving, have parts swapped out, and be handed off smoothly. Whether a module is any good becomes obvious the moment you pull it out and test it in isolation. I'm good at using tools to handle repetitive work, so I can save my energy for the parts that truly need judgement. When I write code I always keep the next reader in mind — understandable, testable, and deletable is the only way I'd call it truly done.
